capabilities: Browse Markdown books in a library sidebar with title filtering
Search book body text through a local background index
Read books in a tab with table of contents and typography settings
Remember reading progress and a recent-books history
Share a single file or pack a folder into a zip
extras: Ships no books: each .md file is one book and the file name becomes the title. Automatic updates download and replace the three plugin files from GitHub after verification; the README states no telemetry or data upload.
problem: Long Markdown documents in a vault can only be opened as ordinary notes, with no library view, body-text search or remembered reading position.

relations.evidence: You can also install it with BRAT by adding ViaCai/living-stone.

summary: Markdown book library and reader that adds a sidebar library, a tabbed reader with typography controls, full-text search and saved reading progress.
